description: Held-out (clean-room, Noûs for Roberto Locatelli, 2026-09-29). Everything binds, no coverage is claimed, but the attestation reaches an EMPTY prefix (attestedPrefixLength 0). n26: «unattested must be its own outcome rather than a pass» — an offline snapshot is otherwise indistinguishable from a verified stream, whether or not a coverage figure is claimed. This is the clean-room reading; Tersign's recorded output on this shape (out-of-suite differential, variant mut0359) is valid, so this vector is where the two readings separate. Declared, not pinned by the 69-vector suite.
